entry.label: Semantic network
entry.description: Joslyn and Heylighen describe a conceptual network with multiple hierarchies and both formal and reader-interpreted meaning. Their technical pages distinguish the proposal from implementation: node types were not really implemented, collaborative status was incomplete, and only one link type was implemented at the time described.
entry.canonical_definition: A representation in which nodes are connected by relations whose types can convey meaning.
